notes: NY only: 5 Boro is a sub-brand of Nanticoke Hemp Inc., Endicott NY (OCM-PROC-24-000002). Its products are in Nanticoke's catalog; this category page holds exactly them, so every item here is 5Boro. Nanticoke's recipe skips them by image folder.

Only the two blunts say '5 Boro' in the title ('5 Boro - Cereal Milk 1.5 g Blunt with Glass Tip'); the prefix is stripped. The strain is everything before the first size ('.7 g', '3.5 g', '1g', '5 Pack Of').

Formats: '.7 g Flower (Dime Bag)' and '3.5 g Flower Pack' are flower; '1g Single Preroll', '5 Pack Of .7g Prerolls' (3.5g) and '1.5 g Blunt with Glass Tip' are pre-rolls. 'Dime Bag' names the 0.7g package, not a line. The site spells the strain 'Hood Candyz' on flower and 'Hood Candy' on the blunt.
